facts.fact: 引路：Quintus 晨（暮光时段）——Umbra 穿帐引 Julian 出营——昨日侦察兵尸体+Taesia 杀之护众——八线圆符已在手，她将图 Divine City。
Shadow Sea 边：talpascor 骨阵（十余具半被影蚀）——Taesia 揭秘：Phos 曾把自己的意识掷入这些兽、逼它们造光墙挡影——「He's always been eager to sacrifice his own.」
facts.anchor: Did you know that Phos can breed more than one kind of soldier?

facts.fact: Julian 的告白：「You don't answer to anyone. Least of all a god.」——她劝退（「Get Nik and Rian as far from me as possible...Nyx wants me to kill them」）——「I am everything they worried I was...Better, in the end, that I become the monster instead of them. Instead of you.」
Nikolas 破局：光速赶到横矛隔人——「Did you lure him here?」——「You know me. Ever the liar.」——Julian 隔身劝架「We need her」。
对质深渊：「Did you see his son's face, Taesia?」——「I saw.」——「Varrick was never going to let you close enough to Phos...His choices were to die then or die later, so I made the decision for him.」
增援与上限：Rian 光速拖人（Fin+Edwin）——「Note to self, new ability limited to three people.」——「We couldn't stop him, it was like… like something took hold of him.」
facts.anchor: new ability limited to three people.

facts.fact: 自毁逼迫：Nikolas 空窝长出光球、抓剑刃按向自己胸口——「Stab me through the heart the way you stabbed him. Let it be the last cruelty you give me.」——她双手握剑时白翼破背（gory stumps）——「This is what I was trying to—What I didn't—Fuck. This ends now.」
facts.anchor: Stab me through the heart the way you stabbed him.

facts.fact: 尾声：Julian 以 Rian 之手缝住她的门（quintessence 线）——众穿门——Orsus 入骨不退（「You will need my help for what is to come」）——Divine City 广场、她画八线圆符没入影——「The Divine City」。
